thought.text: Build succeeded for all 35 projects — the workspace packages now have their `dist/` artifacts, which the Vite dev SSR needs to resolve. Let me restart the app and re-test the UI page and the IAM context.

reasoning_content:
The build succeeded for all 35 projects. Now all the `dist/` artifacts exist. The Vite dev server should be able to resolve the workspace packages now. Let me restart the app (to clear the Vite cache) and re-test the UI page.

Note: `pnpm build` ran `sva-studio-react:build` which is a production build (creates .output). But the dev server (`serve` target) uses vite dev mode. The dist builds for the workspace packages are what's needed for the dev server to resolve them. Let me restart the app.

Actually, wait — `pnpm build` also built `sva-studio-react` (the app itself, producing `.output`). That's fine. The important thing is that the workspace library packages (core, data, auth-runtime, plugin-generic-items, etc.) now have their `dist/` folders.

Let me restart the dev server and test.

action.command:
cd /workspace && pkill -f 'sva-studio-react:ser[v]e' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'run-executor.[j]s' 2>/dev/null; sleep 3
echo "app procs: $(ps -eo pid,args | grep -c '[s]va-studio-react:serve')"
nohup pnpm exec tsx /tmp/launch-app2.mjs > /tmp/launch12.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; cat /tmp/launch12.log
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "live up after ~$((i*5))s"; break; }
  sleep 5
done
